# Illinois SBE official bulk fixture

These small rows were copied from the Illinois State Board of Elections campaign-disclosure bulk files on 2026-07-12:

https://www.elections.il.gov/CampaignDisclosure/DownloadCDDataFiles.aspx

The fixture covers Chicago Mayor, Clerk, and Treasurer; another city; a village; a town; candidates linked to multiple committees; duplicate primary/general candidate-election rows; D-2 amendments; and a ward race that must be rejected. It preserves the published headers and source values so schema drift and join behavior are tested against the real format.
